create_pivot_table: create a spreadsheet-style pivot table from a DataFrame with index, columns, and aggregation functions
create_pivot_without_aggregation: reshape a DataFrame into a pivot table without aggregation using column values as new axes
create_crosstab: compute a cross-tabulation of two or more factors with optional aggregation and normalization
add_margins_to_pivot: add subtotal rows and columns with partial group aggregates to a pivot table
normalize_pivot_table: normalize pivot table values by all, index, or columns with optional margin support
